description: Lets the main window's own remote content (the broker's deployed WebTrader -- see main.rs) invoke the window-control commands the window.vyxDesktop bridge wraps. Scoped to this app's own domains, same allowed-host principle desktop/main.js's will-navigate handler already enforces for Electron. The custom win_minimize/win_toggle_maximize/win_close/remember_broker/forget_broker/retry_connection commands each need their own allow-* permission (see build.rs's AppManifest) because this window loads remote content -- the core:window:* entries below are the BUILT-IN Tauri window plugin's own commands (unused by this app's bridge) and never covered these.
